title: Seashell mix
text: Seashell mix. A lovely mix of various seashells and a few tiny starfish - but too many fakey looking orangish shells in my opinion. On the other hand - they sort of show the orange ones in the photo.  Only in person, the orange ones are really cheapy looking.  In any case, I only needed a few, so the rest of the selections works for me!
